The Buffaload Story
From farming roots to temperature controlled logistics specialists, our journey continues to go from strength to strength.
Their deep-rooted connection to farming has shaped a practical understanding of the food supply chain, inspiring a business built on supporting growers, producers and retailers with the same commitment to quality, sustainability and long-term success.
What began as a small family enterprise, built on hard work and determination, laid the foundations for a business that would grow into one of the UK’s leading temperature-controlled logistics providers.
Seeing the potential to move more with less, Buffaload introduced its first lifting-floor double-deck trailer. The innovation transformed transport efficiency, increasing payload capacity while reducing road miles, fuel use and emissions. It marked the start of a pioneering approach that would help reshape temperature-controlled logistics for a more sustainable future.
As the business continued to grow, Taylor Marketing Logistics became Buffaload Logistics and relocated to Ellington, Cambridgeshire. The move marked a significant milestone, providing the foundations for future expansion while reflecting a clearer identity, greater ambition and a commitment to transforming temperature-controlled logistics.
Beginning a partnership that continues today, Buffaload was appointed as Co-op’s primary logistics provider. Built on shared values, trust and performance, the relationship became a catalyst for growth, helping to shape innovative supply chain solutions while supporting one of the UK’s leading food retailers.
The addition of our Crewe depot marked a major step in expanding Buffaload’s national network, strengthening coverage and capability across the UK. In the same year, we celebrated the arrival of our 200th trailer, reflecting sustained growth, increasing customer confidence and continued investment in our specialist temperature-controlled fleet.
The start of our primary haulier partnership with Tesco marked a major milestone in Buffaload’s growth. In the same year, we opened a dedicated consolidation hub for exports to Ireland, creating a more efficient route to market and extending our capability to support customers with seamless cross-border supply chain solutions.
Marking a major milestone in our sustainability journey, we began the transition to a gas-powered fleet with the delivery of our first generation of 43 Volvo LNG tractor units. The investment reinforced our commitment to reducing emissions, improving environmental performance and leading the way in more sustainable temperature-controlled transport.
Becoming the majority shareholder in ARRA Distribution extended Buffaload’s reach into Wales, strengthening our network and enhancing regional capability. In the same year, our 300th double-deck trailer joined the fleet, marking another milestone in our continued investment in capacity, efficiency and sustainable growth.
Temples Transport strengthened our network, giving Buffaload a presence in Lincolnshire, a major gateway for fresh produce. The partnership expanded our reach across the retail sector, added greater flexibility through Temples’ single-deck expertise and enhanced our offer with a range of value-added services that complement our core temperature-controlled logistics capabilities.
We continued to grow with our customers. We secured a further major, long term, distribution contract with Co-op, to manage their ambient trunking operation based in their Coventry NDC. Further growth with Tesco lead to the opening of our first Scottish depot in Bellshill, strengthening our presence north of the border and bringing us closer to Scottish suppliers and producers. The new location created opportunities to consolidate southbound volumes more efficiently, giving customers greater flexibility, improving network resilience and providing a stronger platform to support retail distribution across the UK.
Buffaload Construction completed our first green field new build. Buffaload Spalding depot represents a major investment in the future of temperature-controlled logistics. Located at the heart of the UK’s largest fresh produce and food manufacturing region, the new facility will increase capacity, improve operational efficiency and create a platform for continued growth. Designed to support the wider adoption of BioLNG and future sustainable technologies, it will enhance resilience across our network while providing customers with greater flexibility, scalability and service capability.

Different by design
More than a traditional consultancy model
Buffaload Consultancy brings together knowledge, experience and practical expertise developed through years of working cross industry, end to end supply chains and multiple business sectors. It is this diverse perspective, combined with a focus on implementation and outcomes, that makes our approach different.
We don’t believe value comes from producing reports that sit on a shelf.
Instead, we give customers access to a network of experienced specialists who have delivered real-world projects, solved complex challenges and driven improvement across a wide range of disciplines.

Supporting the development of engaged and effective teams.

Example: Supporting a growing manufacturer with workforce planning and retention strategies.
Using technology to improve efficiency and visibility.
Reporting & dashboards
Example: Replacing manual reporting processes with automated business dashboards.
Building practical sustainability strategies.

Example: Helping organisations develop realistic environmental improvement roadmaps.
Supporting infrastructure and operational development.

A shared-success commercial model
We believe consultancy should create value for everyone involved working with customers using a shared-benefit model that aligns our success with yours.
This approach demonstrates confidence in the value we can deliver whilst helping customers reduce risk.
Where our expertise helps unlock efficiencies, growth opportunities or commercial benefits for Buffaload, we will remove the consultancy fee.
This aligns our interests with those of our customers, demonstrates confidence in the value we can deliver, and reduces the risk of investing in change.
Let’s Start the Conversation
Every business faces challenges.
The question is whether they’re also opportunities.
Whether you’re looking to reduce costs, improve efficiency, strengthen sustainability performance or develop a growth plan, our team is ready to help.
